# The CTA-861 video identification codes: VIC, active width, active
# height (the frame's lines, both fields of an interlaced format), the
# nominal vertical rate in Hz (the field rate when interlaced), p or i,
# and the pixel clock in kHz at that nominal rate. The 1/1.001 variants
# (59.94, 23.98 ...) share the VIC and are not listed apart.
#
# Source: ANSI/CTA-861-H, section 4 and its video format tables (the VIC
# to format map and the timing of each format), VICs 1-127 and 193-219.
# Pixel-repeated formats list the width on the wire (1440 or 2880); the
# picture aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, 64:27, 256:135) is why some formats
# appear under two VICs and does not change the timing.
# Transcribed by hand without a copy of the standard at hand; to be
# checked line by line against one before anything but a mode list
# relies on it. The table numbers in the standard were not checked.
